reference: Direct indexed-pixel editing of source lettering; standard Italian minigame prompts, no Pokémon-specific terminology.
method: Source glyphs rearranged; P, o, c, u, V edited from source pixel shapes. Full original label background cleared to palette index 0, then dark and green outlines rebuilt around Italian glyphs.
unchanged: Source 16-color palette, canvas dimensions, sprite part mapping, and number/order of animation frames.
limitations: Tempo scaduto! uses two lines at a smaller pixel size to retain complete wording.
